definitions.gloss: purveyor by appointment (to the imperial household); a favorite of
definitions.explanation: Originally a merchant officially appointed to supply goods to the imperial household or a government office ({宮内庁|くないちょう}{御用達|ごようたし}). Today used freely after a noun to mean a shop or product favored by a certain group: {芸能人|げいのうじん}{御用達|ごようたし}, a place popular with celebrities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧{御用達|ごようたし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧。
examples.english: Confectionery supplied to the imperial family.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦セレブ→セレブ：17675_serebu⟧{御用達|ごようたし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧だ。
examples.english: This is a restaurant popular with celebrities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧{御用達|ごようたし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{定食屋|ていしょくや}→定食屋：31623_teishokuya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had lunch at a cheap set-meal diner that the local students swear by.

notes:
Also read ごようだし and ごようたつ; ごようたし is the traditional reading. The modern use is light and often humorous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{宮内庁|くないちょう}→宮内庁：31802_kunaichou⟧{御用達|ごようたし}: purveyor to the Imperial Household Agency
- ⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧{御用達|ごようたし}: by appointment to the imperial family
- ⟦{芸能人|げいのうじん}→芸能人：14959_geinoujin⟧{御用達|ごようたし}: favored by celebrities
- ⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧{御用達|ごようたし}: the professionals' choice
